evals.prompt: Plan original visual assets for a 45-second 9:16 HyperFrames explainer about how AI agents use GPUs and TPUs. Produce asset-plan.json and integration-notes.md only; do not generate images or edit a composition.
evals.expected_output: A selective, style-consistent asset plan that keeps text/data native, specifies fallbacks, and documents Codex image-generation acceptance and QA.
expectations: The plan uses generated imagery selectively and keeps words, logos, UI labels, citations, and factual charts out of generated pixels.
The plan defines one shared style prompt and complete per-asset role, scene, purpose, prompt, output, size, background, quality, and animation fields.
The notes define native HTML/SVG, registry, or verified-source fallbacks and do not silently switch to OpenAI API billing.
The notes require HTML text overlays plus snapshot and strict HyperFrames composite QA.

evals.prompt: An opaque AI-generated robot illustration needs to become a layered subject cutout in a 1080x1920 HyperFrames scene. Produce a production workflow and manifest example; do not run image generation or background removal.
evals.expected_output: A provenance-safe cutout workflow that recognizes GPT Image 2 opacity, uses background removal, verifies alpha, and defines deterministic animation integration.
expectations: The workflow states that GPT Image 2 output is opaque and routes a real cutout through HyperFrames background removal.
The manifest example records provider, prompt hash, content hash, source/delivery paths, and acceptance status without inventing a seed.
The workflow verifies real alpha and inspects the composited hero frame before acceptance.
The integration uses deterministic wrapper/image transforms and preserves HTML typography separately from the raster asset.
